title: Plans & prices for marketers, analysts or agencies | Funnel

# Funnel plans and pricing We have a plan for companies of all sorts and sizes, from tech startup to global media agency. [✦  NEW\\ \\ Start a 14-day free trial\\ \\ No card required](https://funnel.io/pricing#pls-banner) Data Hub Choose from: - 117 connectors - 13 destinations Includes: - Data storage: load pre-synced data into your applications - Semantics: apply your business logic - Context: budgets, targets and business goals - MCP: work with your marketing data in Claude, ChatGPT and other AI tools - Dashboards: build and share reports - Unlimited usage of Funnel AI Funnel Measure - Available on Business and Enterprise Data Hub Choose from: - 579 connectors - 46 destinations Includes everything in Starter, plus: - Data guarantee: connect any source, send to any destination - Reporting destinations: Power BI and Tableau - Cloud destinations: BigQuery, Amazon S3 and more - Unlimited users and workspaces - Advanced Data Hub capabilities Funnel Measure - MMM, MTA and incrementality testing - Available as an add-on, in combination with Data Hub - [Learn more](https://funnel.io/pricing#measurement) Data Hub Choose from: - 600+ connectors - 47 destinations Includes everything in Business, plus: - Additional destination: Snowflake - Enterprise SSO & provisioning: SAML, OIDC and SCIM - User management: advanced roles, permissions and audit log - Enterprise SLA and priority support Funnel Measure - MMM, MTA and incrementality testing - Available as an add-on, in combination with Data Hub - [Learn more](https://funnel.io/pricing#measurement) 14Free trialdays of Data Hub trial ## See what Funnel can do with your marketing data Guided setup with Funnel AI. [Talk to an expert](https://funnel.io/book-demo-measurement) ## Frequently asked questions What are flexpoints? ![dropdown](https://funnel.io/hubfs/Icons/icon-chevron-down-green.svg) Funnel pricing has two parts: your **plan** and your **flexpoints**. Your plan determines which features are available. Flexpoints are purchased **capacity.** You decide what to set up within that capacity, and you can reallocate it freely as your needs change. So Flexpoints are not credits, and not a monthly balance to manage. Will my costs change unexpectedly? ![dropdown](https://funnel.io/hubfs/Icons/icon-chevron-down-green.svg) No. Flexpoints are part of your contract, not a usage meter. You pay for the capacity you've purchased, and that doesn't change based on how much data runs through your setup, how many campaigns you run, or how many rows your connected accounts generate. Your bill only changes if you choose to buy more flexpoints. What's the benefit of the flexpoints model? ![dropdown](https://funnel.io/hubfs/Icons/icon-chevron-down-green.svg) - **Predictable costs** — tied to your setup. You never receive an unexpected invoice. - **Flexibility** — you can easily reallocate flexpoints across connectors, accounts, and destinations as your priorities change. Pause or remove something you're not using to free flexpoints and use them somewhere else. - **Clear control** — see exactly how adding a new account, source, or destination affects your flexpoint usage before you commit to it. How do flexpoints provide flexibility? ![dropdown](https://funnel.io/hubfs/Icons/icon-chevron-down-green.svg) Let's illustrate it with a simple example: say a marketing team decides to stop investing in TikTok and starts testing Reddit advertising instead. They can simply pause their TikTok connector, freeing up the flexpoints it used, and use that same capacity to connect Reddit — no need to buy additional flexpoints just because the channel mix changed. What features require flexpoints? ![dropdown](https://funnel.io/hubfs/Icons/icon-chevron-down-green.svg) **Connectors** e.g. Facebook Ads, Google Analytics _50 FP_ **Accounts** e.g. connected ad account, GA property _5 FP_ **Visualization destinations** e.g. Looker Studio, Google Sheets _150 FP_ **Data warehouse destinations** e.g. BigQuery, Snowflake _300 FP_ **Conversion APIs** Upload data to Google Ads, Facebook Ads and other destinations _50 FP_ **Conversion platform accounts** e.g. connected LinkedIn, Facebook, or Google Ads account _5 FP_ What are connectors, accounts and destinations? ![dropdown](https://funnel.io/hubfs/Icons/icon-chevron-down-green.svg) "Connectors" are the wide range of marketing and sales platforms that Funnel collects data from. An "account" is different for every connector. It can be an ad account, a social media page or a GA4 property. An account connected to Funnel is called a "data source". It's possible to connect the same account multiple times to get data from different report types and breakdowns. "Destinations" are platforms Funnel can send data to, like BI tools, dashboarding tools and data warehouses. Do I pay for my rows of data? ![dropdown](https://funnel.io/hubfs/Icons/icon-chevron-down-green.svg) No. Funnel doesn't charge based on data volume, row counts, or how many report types you pull from the same connected account.
